question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 1.***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"begins to disappear"** correctly uses the infinitive form** "to disappear," **indicating the start of an action.
 
• "Being disappeared" is incorrect because "disappear" is an intransitive verb and does not take the passive form.
 
• "To have disappeared" suggests a completed action in the past, which is not appropriate for this context.
 
• "To be disappeared" is grammatically incorrect as "disappear" does not fit into this construction.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *If we watch closely, we see that the ship begins to disappear__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **To Disappear (गायब होना)**: Correct phrase to indicate the action of starting to vanish.
 
• **Being Disappeared (गायब किया जा रहा है)**: Incorrect passive construction.
 
• **To Have Disappeared (गायब हो गया है)**: Indicates a completed past action, not suitable here.
 
• **To Be Disappeared (गायब होना चाहिए)**: Incorrect grammar.
